NATIVE-TOOLS-OS.visibility_scope: Window-only pixels do not independently establish foreground/on-screen visibility
NATIVE-TOOLS-OS.geometry_scope: CG window coordinates, PNG pixels and declared XML units are distinct; screenshot includes shadow

REA-BLANK-CONTEXT.kind: selected-document REA observation, not a palette-role capture
REA-BLANK-CONTEXT.scope: Empty owned document AX canvas with no tool descendants

STATIC-MAIN-TOOLBAR.kind: bounded standard-library XML metadata fallback, not REA

STATIC-COMMAND-METADATA.kind: bounded standard-library XML metadata fallback, not REA
STATIC-COMMAND-METADATA.locator: CommandDefinition / Command command = reference_command_id; short Tooltip localizationName = declared_tooltip_key
STATIC-COMMAND-METADATA.scope: Only 36 primary cell references; no long help, implementation data or image payloads copied

G25.kind: Publicly hosted older guide, not installed26.1 behavior proof
G25.scope: Tooltip/status-bar role and small-triangle secondary-toolbar convention

layout.correspondence: Visible row = declared column and visible column = declared row is a static/visual matching inference, not a recovered runtime layout algorithm

limitations: CUA App documentation exposes no hover/move method; no click/drag hover surrogate was used.
REA native scenarios support selected AX click, scroll, value entry and wait, not hover. The known layer-zero guard rejects this layer-three palette; that selector was not repeated.
No palette cell or hidden flyout was invoked. Actual tooltip, AX role/action, enabled state and native hit bounds remain unknown.
Button styles and command/handler references are static declarations, not observed dispatch or implemented chemistry.
Commands ending Current do not establish the currently active child tool or its persistence.
Bundled Professional profile and visual correspondence do not establish active entitlement.
Resource-only REA observations have null executable identity; selected resource hashes remain separate from the runtime executable digest.
Reference glyph/font/help/source assets are not licensed for product reuse by this catalog; implement original Bondline logic and assets.
Bondline implementation status is maintained elsewhere and is not assessed by this research catalog.
